# Deck3 ecosystem-wide weakness learning and regression standard V1
**Date:** 2026-10-09 | **Status:** binding methodology for Deck3 and companion design skills; **not** scientific model admission or empirical validation.
**Scope:** Deck3 text-only, figures, one-slide changes, images, infographics, diagrams, engineering frameworks, mathematical visualization, PPTX assembly, animation, QA and release.

## Purpose and authority
Learn from the three compared 13-slide Chapter 1 drafts A/B/C and their documented limitations. Preserve thesis scope (P and complete T_e, extreme heat, physically qualified thermal interdependencies, state-time, electricity/mobility service resilience, two-pathway sustainability and evidence-grounded SDG relevance). The frozen objective wording and approved source text are governance constraints, **not physical validation**. Scientific equations, active model variables, mechanisms and originality remain evidence-tested candidates. Follow canonical science, citations, exact Deck3 color/white-interior and image-routing rules, not invented alternatives.

## Shared error→correction→retest lifecycle
For every substantive error, record: artifact/stage; exact defective element; expected versus observed; scientific or presentation root cause; source/authority; proposed smallest correction; positive and adversarial negative test; actual test method/log and outcome; regression prevention; status PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN. Retain original errors for provenance. Skill improvement is procedural memory, not model retraining. NEVER report specification or checklist creation as execution/test passing.

## Fourteen mandatory scientific/communication gates
T01 Scope remains unchanged, including complete constituent boundaries and exact objective text where presented.
T02 P→T_e and T_e→P pathways separately identified, with source, destination, actual carried AC/interface quantity, physical law/evidence status.
T03 Exogenous ambient heat is not itself directional coupling.
T04 Transformer temperature is never made to imply a power restriction/outage without compatible operating authority.
T05 Physical conservation/accounting equations state measurement boundary, sign convention, units, included auxiliaries, validity assumptions and provenance.
T06 Cross-system state dependencies and algebraic constraints are candidate until admitted physical mechanisms are demonstrated.
T07 Feedback/nonlinear/emergent effects and M0/M1/M2 comparisons are labeled hypotheses until matched scenarios and credible evidence justify them.
T08 State, observations, operating capability, electricity supply, mobility service and reliability/resilience remain distinct.
T09 Numerical/code verification, physical validation, uncertainty and novelty have separate evidence statuses.
T10 Closest-prior-art claims record exact paper-access depth; gaps not asserted as proven without audit.
T11 Direct and response sustainability pathways, environmental/economic/social dimensions and SDG measured-indicator→official-target equivalence check remain present where relevant; `NOT_YET_MEASURABLE` is acceptable.
T12 One useful scientific message per slide, no more than three supporting points except exact frozen-objective slide; purpose-driven arrows/images.
T13 Every externally sourced scientific slide claim has adjacent verified citation; notes and source trace survive assembling.
T14 Frozen decisions are not treated as physical truths; proposed corrections must preserve scope, be traceable and receive authorized review when affecting governance.

## Stage-specific regression obligations
**Deck3 text / Stage 1:** Cite sources near claims, avoid duplicate introductory slides, distinguish physical mechanism and planned research from results, respect approved count/source content, produce text only if user requested text, no PPTX or images in lieu of text.

**Deck3 figures / Stage 2:** Verify real components, boundaries and units; arrow direction and provenance; diagram figure trace sidecar, explicit OPEN/CANDIDATE labels. Scientific illustration vs native editable diagram must follow media routing. No AI embedded explanatory panels or unsupported quantitative chart values. White canvas/interiors and exact palette.

**One-slide edits:** Make the smallest authorized change. Recheck affected slide *and* adjacent slide semantics and trace/citations; preserve untouched slides and exact frozen strings.

**Deck3 assemble / Stage 3:** Retain approved editable native text, notes and source attribution; run source/figure palette tests and actual rendered legibility. 75% figure emphasis applies only to eligible figure-bearing slides, never text-only objectives or source tables. Do not claim playback/animation tested without executing it.

**Deck3 QA:** Report per-test actual evidence with PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN; no aesthetic numerical scoring as physical science certification. Critique equations, laws, validity, system/active model boundaries, citations, visual readability and SDG equivalence.

**Companion infographic:** Show actual mechanism rather than a decorative conceptual taxonomy; visuals supplement source evidence.

**Companion diagram:** All symbols, interfaces and arrow claims registered; common forcing does not become a cross-sector edge.

**Companion engineering framework:** Requirements→physical constituent boundaries→qualified interfaces→dynamics→service outputs; do not add unrequested sectors or theoretical layers.

**Companion mathematical visualization:** Axes, units, equations and variables come from an admitted source/model or are explicitly SYNTHETIC/ILLUSTRATIVE; do not make invented trends look empirical; syntax/convergence of a renderer does not validate physics.

## Adversarial probes to execute, not presume passed
P1: Hot transformer but no equipment operating law → cannot conclude EV charging outage.
P2: Synthetic 55 kW AC, 50 kW DC, 1 kW separately metered auxiliaries inside same boundary → total 5 kW difference, 4 kW other loss, not 5+1 kW.
P3: Two outdoor devices heat together under same ambient forcing → not evidence of cross-system propagation.
P4: Increased project-level departure readiness → not UN SDG 9.1.2 (passenger/freight volume).
P5: Mathematical direct cross-state dependence without physical interface → candidate only or remove.
P6: Earlier frozen candidate law later contradicted by primary evidence → preserve scope, log contradiction and propose authorized revision.

## Acceptance and reporting
Create per-artifact gate ledger with test IDs, observed evidence, proof/locators, unresolved constraints, current quality state and next corrective task. A PASS for text review or trace-schema QA is NOT proof of physical model adequacy, full-source audit, empirical calibration, native PowerPoint playback, or valid SDG achievement.
**First real follow-up:** take the latest approved Chapter 1 deck or text and run T01–T14, with actual detailed evidence and corrective PR before claiming learned behavior has been demonstrated.
